title: Ensure 'Allow a Windows app to share application data between users' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\App Package Deployment\Allow a Windows app to share application data between users to 'Disabled'
reason: Users of a system could accidentally share sensitive data with other users on the same system.

title: Ensure 'Not allow per-user unsigned packages to install by default (requires explicitly allow per install)' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\App Package Deployment\Not allow per-user unsigned packages to install by default (requires explicitly allow per install) to 'Enabled'
reason: In a corporate managed environment, application installations should be managed centrally by IT staff, not by end users.
